app.name: Laufleer
app.description: Discover restaurants across Germany, browse the menu and reserve a table in a few steps.

demo.title: Demo version
demo.notice: Laufleer is not yet in operation. Restaurants can already register; approved profiles then appear here.
demo.bookingWarning: This is a demo application. Your details are not sent to any restaurant — no valid reservation is created.
demo.successWarning: This confirmation is part of a demo. No table has been reserved at a real restaurant.

landing.heading: Your restaurant on Laufleer
landing.subheading: Create a profile, keep your details up to date yourself and take reservations. Free, no contract.
landing.step1Text: Register with your email address and a password.
landing.step2Text: Add address, cuisine, opening hours and a photo.
landing.step3Text: We check the details. Once approved, your restaurant is publicly visible.

signUp.heading: Register your restaurant
signUp.subheading: First create an account. Restaurant details come in the next step.
signUp.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the privacy policy.
signUp.checkEmailText: We have sent you an email. Open the link inside to activate your account.

signIn.heading: Log in
signIn.subheading: Log in to edit your restaurant profile.

impressum.heading: Legal notice (Impressum)
impressum.placeholder: Laufleer is under development and is not in operation. No services are offered and no contracts are concluded. The details required under § 5 TMG (provider, contact, VAT ID, person responsible for content) will be added before launch.

datenschutz.heading: Privacy policy
datenschutz.placeholder: Laufleer is a demo application under development. No analytics or tracking services are used; only strictly necessary cookies are set. Data entered in the reservation form is stored for testing purposes only, in a database inside the EU (Frankfurt am Main), and is not forwarded to any restaurant.
datenschutz.warning: Please do not enter real personal data.
datenschutz.later: The full information required under GDPR Art. 13 will be added before launch.

cookies.message: We only use strictly necessary cookies. No tracking or analytics cookies are set.
